steps.what: sugar, glucose (corn) syrup, fat and flavour
steps.note: Milk, sugar, corn syrup and fat are weighed and blended in a batch.
Steam heats the mixture to a preset temperature while agitators dissolve it.
The mix passes through a steam-jacketed scraped-surface heat exchanger that takes out much of its water.
The thickening batch is recirculated in a steam-jacketed tank until it browns, cooked to about the firm-ball stage.
The caramel is spread about 3.2 mm thick on a water-cooled wheel, where it sets.
A roller shapes the film into a rope, from which pieces are cut and then wrapped one by one.

sources.text: The factory sequence of mixing, evaporating, caramelising, cooling on a wheel, cutting and wrapping, with its temperatures. It describes caramels in general, not a version made from fresh milk specifically.
